about_the_game:
Welcome to Angry Cleaner VR, an absurd comedy stealth game set in an office that completely lost its mind.
You are the night janitor, surrounded by employees who spit on the floor, spill coffee on purpose, and treat the office like a playground. Cleaning up after them would be one thing, but you have a very different plan: to clean up the people too.
Move carefully through desks and hallways, avoid cameras, and deal with anyone who stands in your way.
Angry Cleaner VR blends stealth, absurd humor, and dark tension into one chaotic VR experience where silence is power and the mop is mightier than the boss.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600k or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: SteamVR. OpenXR, Quest 3, Quest 2, Quest Pro, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index, and HTC Vive
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8400 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1070 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Required
  • VR Support: SteamVR. OpenXR, Quest 3, Quest 2, Quest Pro, Oculus Rift S, Valve Index, and HTC Vive.

short_description: The night shift has gone wrong. In Angry Cleaner VR, you’re the janitor in an office full of secrets. Move quietly, take them down one by one, and leave no one behind.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
